subject: Hosting options for NovusPay — residency & cross-region routing
messages:
From: Isabel Schmidt <isabel.schmidt@eurofinlabs.de>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, Tomoko Saito <tomoko.saito@zenpay.jp>
Date: 2026-09-04T07:15:00+02:00
Subject: Hosting options for NovusPay - residency & routing follow-up

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the call this morning — helpful overview. A few clarifications from our side after discussing with Compliance and Risk:

- Primary requirement: transaction-level PII (name, card PAN last 4, address) must remain within the EU for all customers domiciled in Germany.
- APAC requirement: for Japan-based merchants, some transaction data and fraud signals cannot leave Japan under our agreements.
- We are evaluating three hosting modes: Redwood Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs in region), Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem).

Questions we want clarified before the execs decide:
1) If we use Hosted API, can we restrict certain customer traffic to Frankfurt-only and block cross-region routing?
2) For Dedicated capacity, can you guarantee physical isolation and an option for a VPC peering connection into our cloud tenant in eu-central-1?
3) For Private (VPC/on-prem), what is your support for on-prem air-gapped installs and HSM integration? Also what is the timeline for an on-prem pilot?

Attached is a high-level residency matrix we created — fills in some examples of datasets. Can you confirm which hosting mode(s) would be compliant for each row?

Next steps: Can we get an updated technical note + recommended path with risks and timeline for each option? Ideally before our steering committee next Wednesday.

Best,
Isabel
Head of Risk & Compliance
EuroFin Labs

--
Attachment: residency-matrix-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Isabel Schmidt <isabel.schmidt@eurofinlabs.de>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-04T08:40:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Hosting options for NovusPay - residency & routing follow-up

Hi Isabel — thanks for the clear summary and the matrix. I’ve pulled together the initial take below and attached two diagrams for reference. Quick answers first, then recommended next steps.

Summary answers (high level):
- Hosted API: We can route traffic by tenant/route to specific regions (Frankfurt, Tokyo) in most cases, but Hosted cannot enforce a hard legal boundary for data stored in logs/backups unless you select our region-restricted retention and contract addendum. For strict regulatory parity (Germany-only), Hosted is usually not sufficient without additional contract controls.
- Dedicated: Offers reserved GPU pools and regional isolation; with VPC peering we can provide private network connectivity to your cloud tenant in eu-central-1. This is the common compromise for teams that need predictable throughput + strong isolation.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): We support customer-managed VPC control plane and an on-prem distribution for air-gapped installs. On-prem pilots typically take 8–12 weeks to stand up (hardware procurement excluded) and we support HSM integrations via industry-standard PKCS#11 or cloud-KMS bridging.

Risks & notes:
- Cross-region failover: For customers that require strict in-country residency (e.g., Japan), we recommend Private in-country or Dedicated with a dedicated APAC pool per-country where data residency is enforced by routing policies.
- Logs & backups: Hosted default includes centralized logging; we can negotiate segregated retention and physical region scoping for an enterprise contract.

Attachments: redwood-private-arch-diagram.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) Tech deep-dive (60m) — we’ll invite infra/engineering: propose Tue 2026-09-07 09:00 CEST / 16:00 JST.
2) Compliance Q&A — Lauren will review specific legal controls and contract language.
3) Optional: run a short Dedicated pilot in eu-central-1 for 2 weeks as a proof of routing isolation.

If that works I’ll schedule invites and circulate a short note mapping your matrix rows to recommended hosting modes + mitigations.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood-private-arch-diagram.pdf (PDF stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Tomoko Saito <tomoko.saito@zenpay.jp>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, Isabel Schmidt <isabel.schmidt@eurofinlabs.de>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-04T11:05:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Hosting options for NovusPay - residency & routing follow-up

Hi Mateo / Isabel,

Thanks for the context. One point from the Japan product team: ZenPay (JP merchant set) requires that transaction-level features used for payments and fraud scoring never leave Japan — not even transiently — due to contract language with our issuing partners.

A few specific asks:
- Can Redwood Private be deployed inside our existing GCP tenancy in asia-northeast1 and operate in air-gapped mode (no outbound internet) while still allowing your support team limited maintenance windows?
- Do you support HSM-backed key storage that we can bind to our HSM (we run Cloud HSM) and ensure keys never leave JP?
- Is there a cost delta for per-country Dedicated pools vs a multi-region Dedicated cluster? We’d like a ballpark number to evaluate.

If Private inside our tenancy is feasible, we can fast-track procurement — but need a short technical runbook and a compliance checklist.

Regards,
Tomoko Saito
Head of Platform, ZenPay Japan

--
(Short) signature

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: Tomoko Saito <tomoko.saito@zenpay.jp>, Isabel Schmidt <isabel.schmidt@eurofinlabs.de>
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-04T15:32:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Hosting options for NovusPay - residency & routing follow-up

Tomoko / Isabel — appreciate the specifics. Quick operational commitments from our side:

- Private in customer tenancy: yes, we support deployment to a customer-managed GCP project (asia-northeast1) with VPC-only access. Maintenance is performed through customer-approved maintenance windows and a VPN jumpbox; we can produce a support runbook.
- HSM: we support binding to Cloud HSM / KMS and can ensure key material is never exported.
- Pricing: per-country Dedicated pools typically run ~1.5–2.2x the cost of a shared multi-region Dedicated cluster, depending on instance type and SLA. We’ll provide a precise quote after we confirm target concurrency and SLAs.

Next action: Mateo to schedule the technical deep dive (Tue 2026-09-07 09:00 CEST / 16:00 JST) and Lauren to circulate the compliance checklist. I’ll prepare a short cost estimate template and pilot plan.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
(Internal) Lauren: can you please start drafting the contract addendum language around region-restricted retention and SOC2 controls so we can share with their legal team? If you want, I’ll loop in Partnerships for the on-prem SOW template.
